response:
It is completely understandable to feel frustrated when you decide to return to counseling and don't hear back right away. Since you called over the weekend, it is very likely that his 24-hour policy only applies to business days. Many therapists do not check messages on weekends. Because it has been several years, you are likely considered a new client again. He may be checking his current caseload to see if he has an opening, or he might simply be out of the office. 

While therapists generally try to return calls out of professional courtesy, he is not legally obligated to respond immediately since you are not currently an active client. He likely isn't ignoring you intentionally. I suggest giving him a few business days to get back to you. If you still don't hear from him, it might be helpful to leave one more brief message or begin looking for a new counselor who is actively taking clients.
